dice: D66

## Rows

| dice | result | effect | severity | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 11-13 | Wrong Read | You mistake nerves, grief, or fear for deception. Your next social move with this NPC starts from a false assumption. | Low |  |
| 14-16 | Visible Suspicion | Your scrutiny is obvious. The other person notices and becomes guarded or offended. | Low |  |
| 21-23 | Played for a Fool | A liar feeds you exactly the tells you expect. You believe a falsehood until contradictory evidence appears. | Moderate |  |
| 24-26 | Emotional Spill | You push too hard while studying someone. Their strongest emotion erupts openly and the scene grows tense. | Moderate |  |
| 31-33 | Misread Motive | You confuse hate for fear, love for guilt, or loyalty for greed. Any decision based on this read leads you in the wrong direction. | Moderate |  |
| 34-36 | Insulting Probe | Your questions or stare come off as accusatory. The NPC's attitude drops one step. | Moderate |  |
| 41-43 | Turned Against You | The target realizes you are weighing every word and starts manipulating you instead. They gain the upper hand in the conversation. | High |  |
| 44-46 | False Confidence | You become certain you understand the person when you do not. The GM may give you one misleading but plausible conclusion. | High |  |
| 51-53 | Public Misjudgment | You call out a lie, hidden motive, or emotion in front of others and get it wrong. Your reputation in this scene suffers immediately. | High |  |
| 54-56 | Dangerous Truth | You do read a strong emotion correctly, but revealing it at the wrong moment provokes panic, rage, or despair. The NPC reacts dramatically. | High |  |
| 61-63 | Trap of Trust | You trust someone who means you harm or reject someone who was honest. The consequences hit before you can correct the mistake. | Severe |  |
| 64-66 | Fatal Misread | You completely misunderstand the intent in front of you and trigger betrayal, violence, or flight at the worst possible moment. | Catastrophic |  |
